data.narrative: Completed Module 2 CI/CD pipeline design - chose GitHub Actions for CI platform with large marketplace and GitHub integration, chose sequential pipeline shape for simplicity (lint -> test -> build -> push). Implemented secret management using GitHub Secrets to avoid hardcoding credentials. Added pipeline hardening: 15-minute timeout, dependency caching with actions/cache@v4, image size threshold check. Fixed three BREAK issues: secret exposure (removed echo), cache poisoning (corrected cache path), unintended deployments (added branch filter).

dimension_scores.observation: Module 2 focused on CI/CD pipeline design rather than containerization. Containerization quality from Module 1 carries forward. Pipeline builds Docker image with Module 1's multi-stage Dockerfile and security hardening.
dimension_scores.evidence: No containerization-specific exercises in Module 2 - Module 1 containerization carries forward

dimension_scores.observation: Chose GitHub Actions CI platform with sequential pipeline stages (lint -> test -> build -> push). Implemented secret management using GitHub Secrets, pipeline hardening with timeout and dependency caching, branch filtering to only push from main. Fixed three pipeline issues: secret exposure, cache poisoning, unintended deployments.
dimension_scores.evidence: Build step summary: 'Configured CI pipeline with GitHub Actions, sequential stages. Implemented secret management using GitHub Secrets. Added pipeline hardening: 15-minute timeout, dependency caching, image size threshold'

dimension_scores.observation: Pipeline provides observability through log output at each stage. Secrets automatically masked in logs. Image tag with git SHA provides traceability. Pipeline status visible in GitHub Actions UI. Module 2 focused on pipeline structure rather than metrics/alerting.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verification summary: 'No secrets in pipeline logs - registry username/password masked as *** or not present. Image tag matches git SHA confirmed in registry'

dimension_scores.observation: Identified and fixed three pipeline failure modes: secret exposure (echo statement), cache poisoning (wrong cache path), unintended deployments (missing branch filter). Understood root causes and applied correct fixes. Failure-first drill ensured broken tests stop Docker build.
dimension_scores.evidence: Break step diagnosis: 'Secret exposure - debug step uses echo command that prints secret variable. Pipeline slowdown - cache key misconfigured. Unintended deployments - pipeline trigger misconfigured to trigger on all branches'

dimension_scores.observation: Module 2 focused on CI/CD rather than degradation design. Pipeline hardening with timeouts and failure handling provides foundation for degradation patterns. Understanding of branch filtering and secret management supports circuit breaker patterns in later modules.
dimension_scores.evidence: No degradation-specific exercises in Module 2 - focused on CI/CD pipeline fundamentals

dimension_scores.observation: Created comprehensive reflection documentation covering comprehension questions, mini practical task for secret management verification, risk/mitigation analysis, and key takeaways. Documentation is clear and actionable.
dimension_scores.evidence: module2_reflection.md includes secret management verification commands, risk analysis of hardcoded secrets in git, and mitigation strategy

strengths: Chose GitHub Actions based on code location (GitHub) rather than switching platforms
Implemented comprehensive secret management using platform secrets instead of hardcoding
Fixed three pipeline issues: secret exposure, cache poisoning, unintended deployments
Applied pipeline hardening: timeout, dependency caching, image size threshold, branch filtering
data.recommendation: Continue to Module 3 to develop observability coverage skills - logging, metrics, and alerting decisions for production services.

public_evidence.student_action: Configured GitHub Actions CI pipeline with sequential stages (lint -> test -> build -> push), implemented secret management using GitHub Secrets, added pipeline hardening (15-minute timeout, dependency caching with actions/cache@v4, image size threshold check, branch filtering for main only), fixed three pipeline issues (secret exposure, cache poisoning, unintended deployments)
public_evidence.technical_detail: GitHub Actions workflow YAML with stages, secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME/REGISTRY_PASSWORD, timeout-minutes: 15, actions/cache@v4 for node_modules/.venv cache, if github.ref == refs/heads/main for push step
public_evidence.ability: Designing and securing CI/CD pipelines with proper secret management and failure handling
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates understanding of CI/CD best practices including platform selection, pipeline structure, secret management, caching, branch filtering, and pipeline hardening - critical skills for automated, reliable deployments

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Micro-exercise summary: 'CI is factory quality check (linter, tests), CD is conveyor belt (push to registry). Separate concerns allow different testing strategies without touching deployment'
Fix step includes: 'Removed echo statement that printed REGISTRY_PASSWORD, revoked old password, updated CI secret. Platform secret management prevents secrets in git history'
Fix step includes: 'Added condition to push step to only run on main branch. Verified feature branches skip push step, main branch triggers push'

learning_style_signals: prefers systematic fixes over quick workarounds
